text:
ops-bot: Paging: P1 - GPU pool us-east-1-gpu-pool high saturation >95%, inference queue growth. Auto-alert triggered for rt-gpu-prod.

sam: ack — I'm taking initial triage.

maria: seeing huge queue in grafana (inference_queue_length ~ 12k), 99pct latency > 3.2s. HPA not reacting.

ryan: i can confirm. Prometheus adapter logs show repeated 5xx to metrics-server and timeouts.

ops-bot: Recent events: 2026-03-15T14:02Z - sustained enqueue rate spike from onboarding campaign. HPA target metric 'custom.googleapis.com/rt_queue_length' last updated 14:01Z, then adapter returned 500s.

jeff (oncall): i'm joining the channel. sam, quick summary?

sam: symptoms: queue exploding, worker pods saturating GPU, HPA target metric stale (no new scrapes), adapter errors (timeout/read failed). Manual `kubectl get hpa rt-gpu-prod` shows currentReplicas=8, desired=8 (no increase).

lisa: reproducing adapter error:
```
E0315 14:03:12.123 adapter.go:214] error querying custom metrics: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded
WARN 2026-03-15T14:03:12Z adapter: backpressure - queue depth 4096
```

ryan: also seeing `prometheus_adapter_queue_backlog` -> 52k, scrape backlog on prometheus-k8s-0.

infra-bot: Detected nodepool autoscaler at max surge for us-east-1-gpu-nodes (max nodes 120 reached). No further node provisioning possible without quota increase.

sam: immediate plan: 1) live mitigation to reduce incoming load, 2) manual horizontal scale of inference deployment to relieve queue, 3) short-circuit HPA by writing direct metric via metrics-server fallback, 4) investigate adapter backlog.

eve: can we toggle canary routing to route new requests to dedicated-reserve pool? That pool has spare capacity.

maria: yes we have a reserve dedicated pool in us-east-1 with 20% spare. I'll coordinate routing change with router team.

jeff (oncall): do it. add a comment to the incident ticket when done.

sam: executing manual scale now: `kubectl scale deployment/rt-gpu-prod --replicas=24 -n inference`

ops-bot: Action logged: manual scale to 24 replicas by sam at 2026-03-15T14:07Z.

lisa: HPA still shows metrics stale; but additional pods accepted some queue — partial relief. latency dropping to 1.6s. queue now ~7.8k.

ryan: infra-bot shows nodepool still at max; those extra pods are pending on existing nodes via bin-packing -> GPU contention but some pods got scheduled to dedicated-reserve after routing change.

maria: routing change complete — edge-router: route flag `rt-gpu-prod:route_to_reserve=true` flipped. New traffic starting to flow to dedicated-reserve.

ops-bot: Customer-impact note: Several production customers experienced slow responses and request retries between 14:01Z and 14:10Z. No 5xx observed from API front door — retries increased. Engaging CS to notify largest affected customers.

sam: temporary workaround applied: we pushed a patch to prometheus-adapter config to fall back to aggregated scrape if custom-metrics API times out. Rolling now: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/prometheus-adapter -n monitoring`

lisa: adapter pods restarting; logs show backlog draining gradually. adapter error rate dropping.

ryan: while adapter recovers, HPA will need a push — I'll patch the HPA target to a synthetic metric using `external` metric that queries `queue_length` via metrics-server fallback.

jeff (oncall): go ahead, but note change and revert later.

ryan: patched HPA to use `external.metrics.k8s.io/rt_queue_proxy` and bumped maxReplicas to 80. Applied.

ops-bot: HPA desiredReplicas now 40 -> autoscaler can't provision nodes (nodepool at limit) but pods scheduled on reserved pool.

maria: queue down to ~1.6k, 99pct latency ~0.8s. Good.

sam: Thanks all. Current status: mitigation in place — traffic routed to dedicated-reserve, manual scale performed, HPA patched to external fallback, prometheus-adapter rolling restart recovering. Degraded but stabilizing.

eve: CS notified of transient latency/queueing; they asked for ETA on full recovery. We'll say 30-60 minutes while adapter drains.

ops-bot: Note: autoscaler quota / nodepool max hit is a contributor — filed infra ticket #INFRA-6291 to request node quota increase and review nodepool limits.

lisa: quick follow-up logs from adapter showing progress: `adapter_queue_depth=10240 -> 512 -> 128 over 15m`

ryan: root-cause hypothesis so far: Prometheus scrape surge during onboarding campaign created a backlog; prometheus-adapter couldn't keep up -> returned 5xx/timeouts to HPA -> HPA metrics stale -> no scale -> GPU pool exhausted. Secondary factor: nodepool max limit prevented automatic node provisioning and blocked HPA from reaching desired nodes.

sam: action items (short):
- (sam) keep routing to dedicated-reserve until adapter fully healthy and queue < 200
- (maria) follow up with monitoring team to tune adapter QPS/rate limits and add circuit-breaker
- (ryan) revert HPA synthetic external target once adapter healthy; add canary for HPA metric freshness check
- (lisa) confirm infra ticket and expedite quota increase if needed
- (jeff) run postmortem and schedule blameless RCA, include CS timeline

jeff (oncall): I'll own the postmortem. Please add any logs/notes to INFRA-6291.

ops-bot: Incident severity downgraded to P2 at 2026-03-15T14:45Z — system stabilizing.

sam: closing loop: queue at 180, latency nominal, adapter healthy, turning routing flag off in 10m and will monitor.

maria: adding retrospective todo: add HPA metric freshness alert (prometheus-adapter_response_age > 30s) and test autoscaler under scrape-backlog simulation.

ryan: noted. Also recommend a scheduled capacity buffer for onboarding campaigns to avoid hitting nodepool hard caps.

eve: thanks team. I'll update customers once we fully revert routing.

ops-bot: Incident closed (mitigations applied). Final notes: follow-up RFC for adapter hardening and nodepool quota review required.

(END OF THREAD)
